# IIUM Schedule Converter (IIUM Timetable)

> A free web tool that turns an IIUM (International Islamic University Malaysia) course registration confirmation slip into a weekly timetable and a phone or tablet wallpaper.

- Students download their Course Registration Confirmation Slip from i-Ma'luum (Favourite Links > Confirmation Slip > Print > Save as PDF) and upload it.
- The PDF is read entirely in the browser; the slip is never uploaded to a server.
- Each course can be recolored; the result saves as a PNG timetable or a wallpaper sized for common phones and iPads.
- Unofficial student project, not affiliated with IIUM.
